title: Clear Selected Desk Clutter
tests: Tests selective clutter removal without deleting nearby objects the user explicitly wants retained.

judge.summary: The papers and takeaway cup are removed cleanly, with believable wood texture and the laptop, mug, cables, and surrounding scene preserved.

must_haves.item: The papers and empty takeaway cup are absent.
must_haves.why: The foreground papers, papers behind the laptop, and takeaway cup are no longer visible.

must_haves.item: The laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables remain visibly intact in their original positions.
must_haves.why: The laptop, white ceramic mug, and cable tangles remain in place without obvious damage.

must_haves.item: Exposed desk areas have believable surface texture and lighting, without leftover object fragments.
must_haves.why: The cleared areas show continuous wood grain and consistent lighting, with no visible paper or cup remnants.

must_haves.item: The original wide framing and surrounding home-office scene are preserved.
must_haves.why: The viewpoint, image boundaries, window, wall, and surrounding furniture remain unchanged.
